title: South Sound Oral Surgery
description: southsoundoralsurgery.com South Sound Oral Surgery PLLC is an oral and maxillofacial surgery practice based in Lacey/Olympia, Washington State, with a second office in Tacoma, led by board-certified surgeons Dr. Ryan J. Irving and Dr. Andrew C. Chen. With approximately 15 to 25 employees and estimated revenue of 2 to 5 million dollars, it provides dental implants, wisdom teeth removal, bone grafting, orthognathic surgery, TMJ treatment and full-mouth rehabilitation. The practice is equipped with CBCT 3D imaging and CT-guided implant technology for precise surgical planning. It offers all levels of sedation from nitrous oxide to general anesthesia for patient comfort. It accepts most private insurance plans, Medicaid and TRICARE. Serving the South Sound region for over 15 years, it positions itself as the premier oral surgery center between Olympia and Tacoma.
